raw_text:
Review README.md and /src files for repository purpose/structure and update this overview accordingly.

Stack: .NET 10.0 (`net10.0`), latest C#, nullable/implicit usings, `TreatWarningsAsErrors=true`; XML warning 1591 suppressed via `NoWarn`. Projects inherit [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props). Central package management: `ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true`; versions belong in [Directory.Packages.props](Directory.Packages.props), `.csproj` references omit versions. Add packages with `<PackageVersion Include="PackageName" Version="x.y.z" />`.

Layout: `src/`, `tests/`, `Directory.Build.props`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `Template.slnx`. Style: File-scoped namespaces, 2-space indentation, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM, Allman braces; braces except single-line exits; `csharp_prefer_braces = true`; `csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = all`. Private fields underscore camelCase; constants PascalCase; `var` for built-ins/apparent types; `I` interfaces; `Async` suffix. Prefer primary constructors, always assigning readonly fields; top-level entry points; pattern matching; expression-bodied properties/indexers/accessors, but NOT methods. Run `dotnet format`. Use analyzers from [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props); consider NSDepCop. See [.editorconfig](.editorconfig).

Security/config: Use `appsettings.json`, `appsettings.{Environment}.json`, `IConfiguration`, `IOptions<T>`, strongly typed settings, and User Secrets for development.
